name: @nibbin/web
description: Day One web app — grove, Grovekeeper chat, Agent Shop.
//: typescript + @types/node are runtime deps (not devDeps) so Vercel's production install (NODE_ENV=production) keeps them — Next's build-time TS setup check requires the typescript package present even with typescript.ignoreBuildErrors.
//chromium: @sparticuz/chromium + playwright-core are RUNTIME deps (ship to prod) so the serverless launch path in lib/planner/browser.ts can run real Chromium on Vercel. @sparticuz/chromium bundles a brotli-compressed headless Chromium (~50 MB) and exposes args/executablePath()/headless; playwright-core is the Playwright engine WITHOUT bundled browsers (it drives that binary). Neither downloads a browser at install. Full `playwright` stays a devDependency for local dev + the gated live test.
//devDependencies: playwright is a DEV-ONLY dep for the gated live integration test (browser.live.test.ts). Production never installs devDeps and the runtime loads it via a non-static dynamic import, so a missing package simply leaves the browser surface unavailable. Install with PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1 so CI never fetches ~200 MB of browser binaries.
